newsitem.title: UK: Britain's Tate Gallery shut by fire.
newsitem.headline: Britain's Tate Gallery shut by fire.

text.p: More than 40 works of art were removed from London's Tate Gallery on Saturday after an electrical fire broke out under one of the exhibition rooms.
Smoke billowed into the gallery and the public were evacuated after the blaze started in an underground cable duct, a spokesman for the Tate said.
None of the art works was thought to be damaged but the gallery -- London's premier modern art venue -- was closed for the remainder of the day.
